name: Hollow Constable
lore: A dead watch captain remembers every order except whom it was meant to protect.

signature.behavior: Patrol shuffles between locked double volleys; Cordon fires crossing flank fans and a line of arrest stamps; Lockdown pursues while releasing staggered rings with a shared escape wedge. Brutal adds a third ring in Curfew.
signature.counterplay: Move after aim locks. Cross between the Cordon fans, leave the arrest outlines, and follow the overlapping open wedge in the Lockdown rings. Casting plants his feet; successful Accords interrupt pending volleys and give a full stagger window.

artBrief: A dead watch captain remembers every order except whom it was meant to protect. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

name: Carrion Courier

signature.behavior: A single locked delivery becomes a two-leg return route at half health. Every new leg warns from the actual stop. Advanced forms add one leg and a delayed split dispatch fan.
signature.counterplay: Step sideways from each fixed charge lane, read the next arrow after the stop, and punish recovery. Wait for fading trails; the advanced dispatch fan leaves its marked central wedge clear.

artBrief: A messenger runs the same route after the streets and their names have disappeared. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

name: Pallbearer
lore: The coffin is empty. Its bearer keeps making room.

signature.behavior: Advance behind a resistant coffin front and moving cover, then commit to a long straight charge.
signature.counterplay: Flank the coffin, use the moving cover against volleys and attack during the charge recovery.

artBrief: The coffin is empty. Its bearer keeps making room. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

name: Cradle Matron
lore: An infirmary keeper shelters the dead beneath a dress sewn from bed linen.

signature.behavior: Hushed Ward escorts a marked new nest along a connected body-clear route, then calls one gapped lullaby. Cradle Relay moves to the other flank and relays numbered lullabies through surviving nests. Early/late broods have two/four navigating minions, with the existing eighteen-actor cap. Brutal adds thirty separately warned alternating-port needles per calling nest. Crazed retains that prefix and adds sixty crossing needles.
signature.counterplay: Read the harmless pale escort path and the nest growth warning. Broods warn for at least 1.2 seconds; lullabies warn for at least 1.6 seconds and lock an 86-degree gap. Move through the numbered gaps. Destroy nests to stop their future brood and unreleased needles; active rings continue. No surviving nest makes the Matron call alone. All needle headings warn before release and repeated waves remain marked. Actual offset bounds, body width, cover and Hellish lava constrain escort and nest placement. Base combat, art and music remain.

artBrief: An infirmary keeper shelters the dead beneath a dress sewn from bed linen. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

name: Mold Alchemist
lore: A municipal chemist carries a garden that learned to grow without sunlight.

signature.behavior: Pure Culture walks a connected mixing road and grows up to three numbered culture pools. Catalyst sends one moving reaction along the locked road. Decant sends a separately warned return that drains reached cultures. Advanced Reflux runs three reaction legs; Crazed adds a fourth. Brutal adds thirty warned vial needles; Crazed retains the full prefix and extends the spray to ninety with crossing repeats.
signature.counterplay: The pale walking line is harmless. Leave the numbered culture circles during their full 1.3-second warning. Active mold slows and shares one floor hit per half-second. Every moving catalyst locks the full path and warns for 1.5 seconds; step to either side before it moves. Decant returns drain reached cultures, removing their damage and slow. Early pools last five seconds; Decant/Reflux pools persist for at most twelve unless drained. Every spray heading and remaining wave is marked before release. Actual offset bounds, body/pool widths, cover and conservative Hellish lava footprints constrain the mixing road. Base combat values, selected art and individual theme remain.

artBrief: A municipal chemist carries a garden that learned to grow without sunlight. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

name: Bellringer

signature.counterplay: Follow the hollow gap marker as it rotates and cross each ring rather than trying to outrun it.

signature.behavior: Exact Fare warns a complete one-reflection wheel route. Closing Booth shifts position, rolls to a bank, stops, then locks a fresh return toward a survivor. Advanced forms warn side sprays at banks and add a third late leg.
signature.counterplay: Leave the locked wheel line and cross behind the passing wheel. In Closing Booth read the new arrow after its bank stop; it cannot track you after warning. Advanced side sprays warn separately from the wheel lane. Punish the clear recovery.

name: Quarantine Clerk
lore: A thin undead clerk carrying a broad folded ledger and red sealing stamp. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
artBrief: A thin undead clerk carrying a broad folded ledger and red sealing stamp. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Reachable arena-relative stamp centers replace the fixed fallback grid. Standard reopens I early and III late. Brutal chooses one random green number at the start of phase one, holds it throughout that phase and chooses a new random number for each phase-two batch; Crazed chooses a randomly numbered seal in every field. The choice locks and warns with the full field, before any strike. The late Appeal Circuit patrols before marking. Standard uses three red/green stamps, Brutal five including doubled-damage purple stamps, and Crazed ten including black current-health curses. Advanced late appeals replace the expired set after a gap, keeping the live field capped at five/ten. Each reopening precedes a locked, fully warned volley from two/three/four marked origins by form; the green seal visibly absorbs shots at its rim.
signature.counterplay: Active green shelter also increases damage to the Clerk by 50%/35% in Standard, 40%/20% in Brutal and 25%/5% in Crazed (early/late). Crazed phase two leaves two amber infinity domains after each stamp batch. After a separate two-second warning, they remain for the rest of combat and remove 10% of maximum health per contact, bypassing armor and shield capacity, at most once per second across overlapping domains. Green shelter and invulnerability protect. Read the ordered marks and the notched future-safe seal. Wait for its green interior before entering. Follow the new ground origin after a late patrol; advanced appeals warn a fresh set after the old field expires. Purple stamps hit twice as hard as red. The first successful purple contact per player per seal also removes 15% of current health, bypassing armor/shield capacity, and applies three seconds of nonstacking poison (two base damage each half-second) and 35% walking slow; dash speed remains unchanged. Cleanse supplies and Medic cleansing abilities remove both. Green shelter and invulnerability prevent application and poison ticks. Brutal shelter lasts at least 3.5 seconds and Crazed at least five seconds, extending if needed until half a second after the final possible fan echo reaches the rim; black stamps remove 75% of current health once per seal activation, bypassing armor/shields but respecting invulnerability and green protection, leaving at least one health. Shape markings distinguish hazards. The shield outline and closing rim identify temporary shelter from marked volleys; use it to keep firing, or dodge the warned fan in open ground.

name: Chain Marshal

artBrief: A dead gate marshal in a rectangular iron coat carrying two heavy chains. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Held Line plants two clear reachable anchors and warns opposite locked sweeps. At half health, Shifting Writ marks a lateral reposition before placing new anchors, staggers the arms and gives each surviving anchor a freshly aimed reverse sweep after a full new warning. Actual bounds and masonry clip the warned sweep envelope. Advanced anchors warn gapped barb volleys; Crazed later repeats add separately warned crossing angles.
signature.counterplay: Find the numbered anchors before the sweep. Leave the painted sweep, cross behind the passing arm or shoot an anchor to cut only its chain, return and unreleased barb repeats. In-flight shots remain. New phase-two headings lock only when the return warning appears. Every arm gets a complete 1.4-second tell, including the return. Clear masonry blocks the physical chain. Barbs have their own warning and gap; the chain still crosses that gap. Punish the explicit recovery. Anchor health remains 90 Standard/180 advanced; base boss health, damage, timer and grade remain.

artBrief: A mourning corpse whose veil is a single large gate-shaped iron frame. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Three Latches warns two closed lanes and an open numbered crossing. A moving floor pall sweeps the two closed-lane tracks toward the locked target side. At half health, Crossed Threshold marks a real reposition, then warns a vertical gate and a separate horizontal return. Brutal adds gapped latch needles; Crazed retains them, adds crossing needle repeats and one additional separately warned gate.
signature.counterplay: Follow the open numbered lane to cross the gate or avoid the moving floor pall; a timed dash can also cross the pall. The gap is not a bullet shield. Floor sweeps pass under masonry. Every gate gets a full 1.5-second tell, and the pall starts another 0.6 seconds later. Only one gate set can be solid at a time; the next orientation waits for the old set and an exit interval. Read each fresh locked warning and attack in recovery. Original boss health, damage, deadline, attack definitions, fixed grade, art and Third Latch score remain.

signature.behavior: Last Call follows a connected, body-clear perimeter route before one locked rescue-lane charge. At half health, Second Dispatch patrols in the other direction and gives two separately warned headings. Brutal adds one dispatch per sequence and warned gapped door volleys at every stop. Crazed keeps the full Brutal sequence and adds a fourth late dispatch with crossing door repeats.
signature.counterplay: The gold patrol route is harmless. Leave the marked road during its full 1.4-second warning; aim locks before the body moves. Each late heading is warned from its actual new stop. Advanced door fans warn for at least 1.25 seconds and mark all distinct repeat headings; move through their gaps and read the remaining-wave marks before the next departure. The last stop exposes the driver for three seconds and grants the existing 25% boss-damage bonus. Actual map offsets, body width, cover and Hellish lava constrain both route and charge. No instant-kill attack or new art is added.

name: Quarantine Heart
lore: A suspended municipal plague pump in a corpse chest with four broad ivory hoses. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
artBrief: A suspended municipal plague pump in a corpse chest with four broad ivory hoses. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Pump four streams toward the walls; any survivor can turn one valve to reverse a stream into the core.
signature.counterplay: Use a neutral valve or maintain damage from the guaranteed open side; no particular class is required.

name: Crown Procession
lore: A dead civic ruler borne on a large simple palanquin by four skeletal attendants. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
artBrief: A dead civic ruler borne on a large simple palanquin by four skeletal attendants. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Four attendants carry the throne along visible waypoints; defeating one lowers the throne for an opening.
signature.counterplay: Focus any attendant or use the next scheduled throne rest; damage is never locked behind group participation.

name: City Eater
lore: An enormous hollow corpse whose clean rectangular jaw resembles a civic arch. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
artBrief: An enormous hollow corpse whose clean rectangular jaw resembles a civic arch. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Mark two bite lanes and leave one broad escape corridor; destroyed temporary walls expose the core.
signature.counterplay: Use the unmarked corridor and the long recovery; static arena exits never disappear.

name: Saint of the Last Breath
lore: A towering dead hospital saint under one pale sail-shaped shroud with an iron respirator. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
artBrief: A towering dead hospital saint under one pale sail-shaped shroud with an iron respirator. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Alternate inhalation that gently pulls and exhalation that sends slow rings; two shelter pads cancel the pull.
signature.counterplay: Use either shelter or steer outward; solo needs only one pad and normal dodge remains available.

name: Hourglass Widow

artBrief: A narrow veiled corpse holding one oversized sandglass against a smooth black dress. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Record one slow bullet fan and replay its same path once after a visible countdown; never rewind players or health.
signature.counterplay: Remember the dashed replay paths or use the persistent safe flank.

name: Unlit Astronomer

artBrief: A dead astronomer beneath one dark circular star chart with a short brass telescope. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Move two large orbiting hazard markers around the core while a third harmless marker outlines a safe orbit.
signature.counterplay: Follow the clear hollow safe marker; visual paths remain readable without glow.

name: Folded Man

artBrief: An angular corpse folded into one large paper-coat silhouette with a black seam. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Fold a visible line across the floor; bullets cross the line at a mirrored angle after a long warning.
signature.counterplay: Use the permanently unreflected side; predicted paths show both entry and exit directions.

name: Red Comet

artBrief: A dead meteor courier wrapped in one broad red scarf and a long tapered brass shell. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Dash through three fixed waypoints, leaving trails that go harmless in the order they were created.
signature.counterplay: Follow the numbered path and cross the oldest faded trail.

name: Memory Taxer

artBrief: A blind corpse assessor carrying one large empty portrait frame and a square ledger bag. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Show three large safe-pad symbols, then request the first shown symbol before a bounded outside pulse.
signature.counterplay: Use the numbered visual history that stays on the HUD; memorization is optional and accessible.

name: Choir of Moths
lore: A silent corpse singer in one wide moth-wing shawl with three large ivory eye shapes. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
artBrief: A silent corpse singer in one wide moth-wing shawl with three large ivory eye shapes. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Release three cohesive moth ribbons along curved paths; one ribbon visibly breaks to create a crossing.
signature.counterplay: Cross at the broken ribbon and ignore decorative wing dust, which is not generated.

name: Zero-Hour Conductor
lore: A dead conductor with a broad metronome torso and one long baton. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
artBrief: A dead conductor with a broad metronome torso and one long baton. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Count four visible beats and release one alternating lane pattern on each beat with a fixed safe syncopation.
signature.counterplay: Read the persistent beat pips and safe lane marker; audio rhythm is never required.

name: Walking District
lore: A monumental corpse bent around three broad civic roof shapes and one central bell. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
artBrief: A monumental corpse bent around three broad civic roof shapes and one central bell. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Lift two temporary building blocks and shift them along outlined lanes, exposing one large central weak point.
signature.counterplay: Use the broad outer bypass or the cleared central path after the blocks settle.

name: The Last Knocker
lore: A faceless corpse carrying one immense upright front door and a single brass knocker. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
artBrief: A faceless corpse carrying one immense upright front door and a single brass knocker. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Knock three times before the door swings through a marked sector; the opposite sector remains open.
signature.counterplay: Follow the three visible knocks and move behind the hinge; attack during the open-door recovery.

name: Ashen Usher
lore: Still seats visitors in a hall no one can find.

signature.behavior: Breakable ticket stands release staggered aisle volleys. Dismissal crosses the rows; Final Call adds a second sweep while the usher walks between calls.
signature.counterplay: Read the locked rays and cross after a volley, or destroy a ticket stand to cancel every pending shot from that stand.

artBrief: Still seats visitors in a hall no one can find. Preserve the issued original concept and complete motion poses.

name: Brass Toad
lore: The abandoned fountain learned to drink the rain.

signature.behavior: Locked landing circles precede physical hops and gapped ripple projectiles. Downpour adds a second landing; Dry Mouth follows with a narrow tongue lane.
signature.counterplay: Leave the landing circles, cross the broad ripple wedge and sidestep the locked tongue line. Breaking the drain plug cancels its tongue jet.

artBrief: The abandoned fountain learned to drink the rain. Preserve the issued original concept and complete motion poses.

name: Ragpicker's Kite
lore: Its tether still pulls above a deserted street.

signature.behavior: A floating orbit surrounds warned wind corridors. Crosswind adds opposing corridors with a quiet center; Unravelling staggers three wing fans.
signature.counterplay: Use the quiet center, steer against the marked arrows or break a cloth pin to remove its wind. Dodge briefly suppresses wind force.

artBrief: Its tether still pulls above a deserted street. Preserve the issued original concept and complete motion poses.

name: Candle Snail
lore: A single light still travels the cemetery path.

signature.behavior: A slow collision-resolved glide lays locked warned wax rails. Twin Wick adds parallel rails with a quiet center and faster lateral movement.
signature.counterplay: Leave the marked wake before it burns, cross after it cools, or use the quiet center between twin rails. Masonry stops the wake.

artBrief: A single light still travels the cemetery path. Preserve the selected original motion, permanent identity marks and complete defeat poses.

name: Cobble Crab
lore: The street gathers its loose stones at the sound of footsteps.

signature.behavior: Warned stone pincers physically close toward a locked strip while the crab scuttles sideways. Cross Streets alternates axes and adds a second closure.
signature.counterplay: Leave the closing jaws or break their linked finite anchor stone. Pass through after a clamp; the outer lanes remain open.

artBrief: The street gathers its loose stones at the sound of footsteps. Preserve the selected original motion, permanent identity marks and complete defeat poses.

name: Mourning Kettle
lore: It keeps the last tea warm for guests who never returned.

signature.behavior: A marked steam lane pours before crossing condensation beads. Last Service staggers two separated lanes while the kettle waddles between casts.
signature.counterplay: Sidestep the warning, cross after steam ends or break a finite remote valve to cancel its linked pour and beads. Preserve a cold route.

artBrief: It keeps the last tea warm for guests who never returned. Preserve the selected original motion, permanent identity marks and complete defeat poses.
